label: Sales
description: Selling to a prospect or customer on this call: their needs, the product, pricing, quotes, contracts and licences for a purchase or a new project, objections, competitors and closing the deal. The advisor is pitching a product or service.

intents.name: discovery
intents.description: The customer describes their needs, their current setup or what they are looking for.
intents.guidance: Ask one open question about the problem behind the request, who decides and by when. Do not pitch yet.

intents.name: product_question
intents.description: The customer asks how the product works or whether it supports something.
intents.guidance: Answer only from what was said on the call; if unsure, offer to confirm instead of guessing. Link the answer to the need they gave.

intents.name: price_objection
intents.description: The customer says it costs too much, compares prices or asks for a discount.
intents.guidance: Acknowledge the concern, ask what they compare it with, then restate the value for their need before any discount. Never invent prices or offers.

intents.name: competitor_mention
intents.description: The customer names another vendor or an alternative they use or consider.
intents.guidance: Ask what they like about it and what is missing; compare on the need they care about. Never criticise the competitor.

intents.name: timing_objection
intents.description: The customer wants to wait, think it over, or says it is not the right time.
intents.guidance: Ask what would need to be true to go ahead and agree a concrete next step with a date.

intents.name: buying_signal
intents.description: The customer asks about contracts, onboarding, start dates, payment or next steps.
intents.guidance: Confirm the choice and propose the next concrete step: quote, order or onboarding booking.

intents.name: general
intents.description: Anything else about this topic that fits no intent above, or an unclear line about it (greetings, thanks and goodbyes are general.*).
intents.guidance: Suggest the next useful question that moves the conversation towards the customer's need.

facts.description: The problem or goal the customer wants solved
When they want to decide or start
Who makes or approves the decision
What they use today, including competitors

phrase_rules.speaker: customer
phrase_rules.hint: Price concern: ask what they are comparing it with before offering any discount.

phrase_rules.speaker: customer
phrase_rules.hint: Stall: ask what is holding them back and agree a follow-up date before the call ends.

phrase_rules.speaker: customer
phrase_rules.hint: Confirm their email and offer a short follow-up call to go through the details.

phrase_rules.speaker: customer
phrase_rules.hint: Buying signal: confirm the plan and quantity, then move to the order or onboarding.

fact_rules.hint: Budget not known yet: ask what range they have in mind.
Ask who else is involved in the decision.
